> "Authorized Quellwyn dealer. Full manufacturer warranty."

Ottervale Audio (Listing B) does not make that claim.

With no price, shipping, or return-policy downside, the authorized dealer is the safer choice — you're more likely to get a genuine product and have the full manufacturer warranty honored.
